solution.text:
Here,

NaOH gives NaClO3 on reaction with chlorine gas.

CaOH2 gives CaOCl2 on reaction with chlorine gas.

6NaOH+3Cl2hot and conc→NaClO3A+5NaCl+3H2O2CaOH2dry+2Cl2→CaOCl2B+CaCl2+2H2O

CaOCl2 is known as bleaching powder.
